tools.name: sql_query_sensor_readings
tools.description: Query time-series sensor telemetry from fact_sensor_readings for an equipment over a time window, optionally filtered by metric name.

tools.name: sql_query_alarms
tools.description: Query historized alarm events from fact_alarms for an equipment over a time window.

tools.name: sql_query_maintenance_history
tools.description: Query consolidated work order/notification history from fact_maintenance_history for an equipment, including downtime hours, cost, and closure dates.

tools.name: sql_query_equipment_dimension
tools.description: Query equipment master/dimension data from dim_equipment (criticality class, install date, description), synced from SAP PM.

tools.name: sql_insert_failure_prediction
tools.description: Insert a new model output row into fact_failure_predictions (anomaly score, contributing metrics, RUL estimate, model_version). This is a write action restricted to the designated output table; it does not modify any source-of-record table and does not require human approval, but every insert is logged with model_version, agent_id, and generated_at for audit traceability.
